## Outcome
axe-core in `window.__axe()`, the per-frame sampler and the Drawer laws (Y2 is U111's real-window check), `loop/rules.sh laws` (prompt `.work/prompts/v-verify.md`) (Moves: none)

## Acceptance
Scenarios: Y1, Y2, Y3
Specification: [scenarios/ui-verify.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/ui-verify.md)

## Scope
`apps/desktop/src/testing/**`, `apps/desktop/harness.html`, `apps/desktop/package.json`, `loop/rules.sh`, `loop/rules.test.sh`

## Preserve
`u26_` and `u137_` tests, the `loop/rules.sh` tests

## Dependencies
U137 merged (it owns `testing/`), the U111 and U131 Builders merged (so `u111_` and `u131_` tests exist, or the sheet exits 1 at birth), a `u41_` test on main, and L41 merged, so `loop/rules.sh` has one writer at a time; Y3 is the one `loop/rules.sh` slice here and starts last

## Delivery
No implementation PR linked yet.

## Queue
Key: Y1-Y2-Y3
Priority: 100
Migration state: waiting

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

goals.statement: Y1: on a `just harness <seed>` page at 1280 by 800, `window.__axe()` runs axe-core's `color-contrast` and `aria-*` rules and returns `{violations, incomplete}`, each entry `{rule, selector, value}`. The fixture pages in the scenario give one `color-contrast` violation, one `incomplete` entry and one `aria` violation. The seeds `first-run`, `agents-10` and `tree-40` return no violations. A missing axe bundle throws. Where D5 and `color-contrast` disagree, the check fails and names both selectors.
goals.observer: `y1_` tests on main pass, and a headless agent-browser session (fresh profile) on `just harness` evaluates `window.__axe()` on each of the three seeds and records the result

goals.statement: Y2: a sampler in `apps/desktop/src/testing/` reads every animation frame from the click until 300 ms after the slide ends. It runs while a Todo Drawer and a Pad Drawer each open and close, at 1280 by 800 and at 640 by 400. In every frame, `scrollLeft` of the element holding the Rail, terminal and Shelf is 0, and the summed layout-shift for those three is 0. The sampler returns the frames it read. The old `overflow: hidden` fixture fails and names its first bad frame. A run that reads no frames fails.
goals.observer: `y2_` tests on main pass, and the sampler's returned frames are inspected in the harness Chromium at both sizes

goals.statement: Y3: on main, `loop/rules.sh laws` prints only `id | sentence | check` lines, sorted by id. Its output includes the U111 (`y2_`), U131 (`u131_`) and U41 (`u41_`) laws. It exits 1 for a Law with no Check (printed `unchecked`) and for a Check prefix that matches no test. It exits 4 when `scenarios/` is missing.
goals.observer: Running `loop/rules.sh laws` on a main checkout prints the three laws and exits 0, and the `y3_` tests in `loop/rules.test.sh` pass
